messages:
sara: Hey team — quick clarification. I'm going to the Berlin summit (May 12–15) but extending my trip 2 nights for personal vacation. The company covers hotel for 12–14 only. I have one booking that includes May 11–16 on the same reservation. Can I claim shuttle from the airport for the company nights only, plus per‑diem for 12–14? Also the hotel folio combines charges across the entire stay. Any tips to split on Expensify? cc @mike @lucy

mike: :wave: Short answer: yes, we reimburse travel/shuttle and per‑diem only for business nights. You need to split charges or submit an itemized attestation if the folio can't be split. Please include copy of itinerary showing conference dates and a calendar invite. Tip: book separate room nights if possible next time.

lucy: Finance checklist: 1) Shuttle/taxi receipts for business nights (one per ride) 2) Hotel folio — either an itemized folio with nightly charges OR a short attestation (if hotel refuses itemization) 3) Proof of business dates (conference reg or calendar invite) 4) If you pay personal nights on same card, mark those as personal and don't claim. :memo:

sara: What about gratuities on shuttle? I tipped €10 at pickup — can I claim that proportionally? Also the hotel charged a mandatory city tax + a resort/amenities fee — company covers lodging but not optional amenities, right?

mike: Gratuities for ground transport are reimbursable if reasonable and documented, so include the shuttle tip with a receipt or card charge line. Mandatory taxes/fees tied to the room are generally eligible; optional resort amenities (spa, pay TV, minibar) are not. If the folio labels the fee as 'mandatory' we'll usually treat it as part of lodging.

devon: Practical Expensify workflow: create two expenses under the same trip — one expense for business nights with hotel nightly lines (or attestation note) and one marked 'personal' for the extra nights. Add the project code `CONF-BER-24` and tag `people-ops-approval`. Example note: `Hotel split: 12/13 €120 (business) | 13/14 €120 (business) | 14/15 €0 (personal)`. Attach the full folio and the conference invite.

travel-bot: Policy excerpt: "Per diem applicable only for nights that are business-related. Receipts required for transport and lodging; lost receipt attestation allowed up to €75 per item with manager approval."

sara: Thanks — I'll try to get an itemized folio. If the hotel won't split, I'll submit an attestation and flag for manager approval. One more Q: can I claim airport lounge access used during a business leg? I have a receipt for lounge access on the return day that was after the conference.

lucy: Lounge access is reimbursable if it was used during business travel (e.g., between flights on a business leg). If it was during your personal extension return day and not required for business, mark it personal. Upload the receipt and add a short rationale.

mike: If you'd like pre-approval for any edge cases, ping me or book via travel ops and note "hybrid personal extension" so we can pre-clear.

sara: Awesome — submitting today. Thanks! :pray:
